title: Block Out Level 9 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 9 is a twin-tower puzzle with a cramped middle notch. Clear the right yellow exit first, give blue the center cavity, then rotate green, pink, and red clockwise around the frame.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 9 is a twin-tower puzzle with a cramped middle notch. Clear the right yellow exit first, give blue the center cavity, then rotate green, pink, and red clockwise around the frame.
landmarks: Block Out Level 9 is a twin-tower puzzle with a cramped middle notch.
Clear the right yellow exit first, give blue the center cavity, then rotate green, pink, and red clockwise around the frame.
The board mixes Pink, Red, Yellow and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Use the right yellow exit to break the symmetry.
The center blue block should move as soon as the notch opens.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Slide the mid-right yellow block out through the yellow gate on the right wall.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Move the center blue block into the new opening so the middle notch is no longer blocked.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Rotate the lower-right green block downward and then pull the lower-left blue block into its own lane.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Use the freed center to shuffle the pink blocks across the top and middle rows while the edge counters shrink.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Let the lower red block settle into the center once green and blue are no longer crossing it.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Save the two top-corner red blocks until the upper lanes are clear.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish by sending the red pair across the top exits and letting the final blue block drain through the last blue finish.

failurePoints: Leaving the center blue block parked after the right yellow exit is already open.
Trying to force one of the top red blocks before the lower green and blue pieces have rotated.
